post.description:
Run a single iteration of the agent.

State Flow:
1. Load/create persistent AgentSession (session state) in backend
2. Get trial-related information (only for existing_strategy scenario)
3. Update session with request inputs
4. Create run state (AgentRunState) from session + request
5. Call Agent Service internal API to run
6. Extract results and update session
7. Store observability data (logged, not persisted to session)
8. Return response to client

Args:
----
    request: The request containing scenario and context information.

Returns:
-------
    AgentRunResponse: The generated code and session information.

Raises:
------
    HTTPException:
        If session is not found, agent service error occurs, or run fails.

Get aggregated metadata for an agent session.

This endpoint parses session logs to extract run-level metadata,
then aggregates across all runs to provide session-level totals.

Session-level: Aggregates metrics across all runs in the session
Run-level: Individual run data available in the `runs` list

Returns
-------
    AgentSessionMetadataModel: Session-level aggregated metadata including:
    - session_id: str
    - total_runs: int (session-level: count of runs)
    - total_input_tokens: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_output_tokens: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_tokens: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_llm_calls: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_nodes_executed: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_duration_seconds: float (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - total_code_validation_attempts: int (session-level: sum across all runs)
    - runs: List[RunMetadataModel]  # Run-level: per-run breakdown

AgentRunResponse.title: AgentRunResponse
AgentRunResponse.description:
Response model for agent run.

Attributes
----------
    session_id: Session ID for the agent run
    run_number: Run number for this session

          generated code for debugging purposes. None only if generation failed
          before producing any code.
    status: Status of the run (running, success, failed)
    error_message: Error message if the run failed

ExperimentConfig.title: ExperimentConfig
ExperimentConfig.description:
Configuration model for experiments creation.

Attributes
----------
    number_of_trials: Number of trials to run for this experiment
    strategy_name: The name of the strategy class to use
    strategy_parameters: Dictionary of strategy parameters and their possible values
    trading_eac: Exchange-asset combinations that are relevant for trading
    benchmark_eac: Exchange-asset combination that is used as benchmark
    portfolio_currency: Portfolio currency
    initial_investment: Initial investment per exchange in the portfolio currency
    since: Start time in ISO8601 format
    until: End time in ISO8601 format
    candle_interval: Candle interval for OHLCV data
    backtesting_cycle_window: Backtesting cycle window in milliseconds
    max_backtesting_cycles: Maximum number of backtesting cycles to run
    test_market_data_objects_ids: [Test Mode] List of market data objects ids
        to use for testing. Optional.
    test_benchmark_market_data_id: [Test Mode] Market data object id
        to use for testing. Optional.
